newsitem.title: USA: Basin Electric 550 MW Wyo. unit seen up late Fri.
newsitem.headline: Basin Electric 550 MW Wyo. unit seen up late Fri.

text.p: Basin Electric Power Cooperative said Friday it expects the 550-megawatt unit 3 at its Laramie River Station coal-fired power plant to reach full capacity late Friday night following repair of a tube leak.
The unit has been shut since Wednesday and will begin restarting about 1100 MDT/1300 EDT Friday, said spokesman Stan Stelter.
The plant's other two 550-MW units continue to operate at full capacity, he added.
Basin Electric, headquartered in Bismarck, N.D., is the operator of the Laramie plant and holds a 42.27 percent ownership stake. Five other Midwest public utilities co-own the plant.
